随着证据链不断完善，最终真相呼之欲出，徐晨安和老拐先后选择交代，主动跟警方摊牌。
老拐嗓音沙哑：“我跟殷鹏是在广州的时候认识的，那时候他在南边做生意，他那人很变态。”
“最开始那两年，生意很差，殷鹏就主动拜了位大师，说是大师，其实就是一江湖骗
一句不算响亮的话语，却带着无尽的坚决，此话落在严保耳中，他的脚步停了下来。
而听到吴秀莲狂喊的尖叫声后，众人纷纷拿着武器，做好防备才赶了过来，大家第一时间都以为闯进来的几人变成了丧尸。
“这样的事情竟然不一早告诉我！”范直接把那封信丢到了地上，而且还踩上了几脚。阿维预想到对方会有这样的反应，他没有搭话，只是让对方慢慢消化掉这几件事。
“好一个伶牙俐齿的护国上师！”一道明朗清澈的年轻男子声音从黑暗中传来。
“那就接受主的神圣制裁吧！”圣殿骑士举起长枪从空中急冲下来，犹如一枚发射出的炮弹。
“你发现了什么？”看到香月一面凝神却又疑惑的神情，叶风马上就问了。
不一会儿，整片区域都是被安如烈的金甲卫所斩的人头的鲜血染红，真可谓是是血流成河。
萧漠对于军队的乱七八糟的称呼弄得很是无语，只是建国之前的所有士兵都是统一从军营里训练出来的，所以就会产生这种麻烦。而建国之后的军营也自行变成了一堆资源返回到了萧漠的口袋里，军营建造图纸也再也用不了。
“饶了你？哪有那么容易？给我舔下面，本少爷舒服了，对这件事情既往不咎。”毒瘤语气严厉，指着自己的下身。
在这样的场景下，鬼柴田跟随着阿弥陀丸的动作，一同从怀中拉出了一条残破的布，那是破旧不堪的布，可鬼柴田将他完好的保存在怀中，仿佛上百年的时间经受雷劈，都在好好的保护，只为了今天这一课能够拿出来使用。
锦卿从床头的木箱子里翻出了冬天穿的厚袍子，轻轻的盖到了锦知身上。锦知也渐渐长大了，不好再跟自己和嬷嬷睡一张床了，等过了这个冬天，锦卿准备托徐斌打张竹床放堂屋里，分开睡好了。
自己的命明明就像被人捡回来一样，如此狼狈！不知道被谁救了，她朝着之前魔炮攻来的方向看去。
“发生了什么事，居然吹响决战号角？难道是日耳曼联军兵临城下了？”刚急急忙忙跑上城楼的奥卡一眼就看到正扶着堞墙向外眺望神情凝重的达利尔。
锦卿当场惊呆了，等回过神来后一个心止不住的狂跳，怎么也镇定不下来。

“唔……已经追踪之中，但是对方的手段相当高明，想要找到其最终去向，需要花一点儿时间”审判的话语中透露出一丝的无奈。
这种房子漏雨可不是一家就能解决的事，林爸林妈只能简单的在林家房顶子上面铺上防雨布，又压了一些砖头之类的就算完事了。
难不成，原本被自己圈定为猎物的熊启，才是那真正的猎人么？心中忽然生出这种想法的达摩利斯不禁苦笑。
“兄弟，‘抽’根烟。”年龄最大的忽然笑了起来，掏出一包便宜烟‘抽’了一根递给了萧明，萧明接住后点燃叼在了嘴上。

As the evidence chain continued to improve, the final truth was about to come out. Xu Chenan and Lao Guai successively chose to confess and took the initiative to show off with the police.
Lao Guai's voice was hoarse: "Yin Peng and I met when we were in Guangzhou. At that time, he was doing business in the south. He was a very perverted person."
"In the first two years, business was very poor, so Yin Peng took the initiative to worship a master. He said he was a master, but in fact he was just a charlatan.
It was not a loud word, but it was filled with endless determination. These words fell in Yan Bao's ears, and his footsteps stopped.
After hearing Wu Xiulian's wild screams, everyone rushed over with weapons in hand and prepared themselves. Everyone immediately thought that the people who broke in had turned into zombies.
"You didn't tell me such a thing earlier! Fan directly threw the letter to the ground and stepped on it a few times. Avi expected that the other party would have such a reaction, so he did not speak to him and just let the other party slowly digest these things.
"What a sharp-tongued guru who protects the country! "A bright and clear young man's voice came from the darkness.
“Then accept the Lord’s divine sanction! "The Templar raised his spear and rushed down from the air, like a fired cannonball.
"What did you find? "Seeing Xiangyue's focused but confused expression, Ye Feng asked immediately.
After a while, the entire area was stained red with the blood of the heads chopped off by An Rulie's golden armored guards. It could be said that the blood flowed like a river.
Xiao Mo was speechless at the messy names for the army. It was just that before the founding of the People's Republic of China, all soldiers were uniformly trained from military camps, so this kind of trouble would arise. After the founding of the People's Republic of China, the military camps turned into a pile of resources and returned to Xiao Mo's pocket, and the military camp construction drawings could no longer be used.
"Spare you? How can it be that easy? Give me a lick down there. This young master will feel comfortable and forget about this matter. "The cancerous tumor spoke sternly, pointing at his lower body.
In this scene, Oni Shibata followed Amidamaru's movements and pulled out a tattered piece of cloth from his arms. It was a shabby cloth, but Oni Shibata kept it intact in his arms, as if he had been struck by lightning for hundreds of years and was well protected, just to be able to use it for today's lesson.
Jinqing took out a thick winter robe from the wooden box beside the bed and gently covered Jinzhi. Jinzhi has gradually grown up, and it is no longer easy for him and his grandma to sleep in the same bed. After this winter, Jinqing plans to ask Xu Bin to make a bamboo bed and put it in the main room, so that they can sleep separately.
His life was obviously as if someone had picked him up, so embarrassing! Not knowing who had saved her, she looked in the direction where the magic cannon had attacked.
"What happened to actually blow the decisive battle horn? Could it be that the German army is approaching the city? "Oka, who had just hurriedly ran up the tower, saw Daryl who was holding on to the battlement wall and looking out with a solemn expression.
Jin Qing was stunned on the spot. When he came to his senses, his heart was beating wildly and he couldn't calm down.
"Well...it's already being tracked, but the other party's methods are quite clever. It will take a while to find its final whereabouts." There was a hint of helplessness in Judgment's words.
This kind of leaking house is not something that one family can solve. Lin's parents and Lin's mother can simply put a rainproof cloth on the roof of the Lin family's house and put some bricks on it, and that's it.
Is it possible that Xiong Qi, who was originally designated as his prey, is the real hunter? Damoris, who suddenly had this thought in his mind, couldn't help but smile bitterly.
"Brother, smoke a cigarette. "The oldest HuRan laughed, took out a pack of cheap cigarettes, smoked one and handed it to Xiao Ming. Xiao Ming caught it, lit it and held it in his mouth.
